       coax proto   profile.pb --prefix Name [-o output.coax]
       coax layout  file.coax
       coax deps    file.coax                           JSON source/descriptor inputs
       coax deps    file.coax --declarations            JSON logical owners, declaration IDs, references
       coax query   file.coax defines NAME | uses NAME | exports [MODULE] [--json] [--fresh]
       coax deps    file.coax --lowering [--proc NAME]  JSON ordered lowering: operations, traps, sequencing
       coax deps    file.coax --effects [--proc NAME]   JSON transitive may-effects and witness paths
       coax deps    file.coax --modules                 JSON module content and dependency revisions
       coax test    file.coax [--steps N] [--slots N] [--only SUBSTR] [--list] [--profile steps] [--evidence FILE]
       coax mutate  file.coax [--jobs N] [--shard I/N | --merge RECORD...] [--evidence FILE]
                    [--root-only | --unit PART.coax] [--killers FILE] [--source-order]
                    [--mutation-reference] [--mutation-stats] [--mutation-trace]
                    --root-only mutates entry-source procedures; all baseline checks still run
                    --unit PART.coax mutates one loaded unit's procedures; every check still runs
                    --killers FILE runs each mutant's last killing check first and records
                    this run's; the verdicts are the same with or without it
                    each mutant tries its likely killers first (the file's, then this run's,
                    then checks entering its procedure, cheapest first); --source-order
                    (implied by --mutation-trace) runs the rest in source order instead;
                    only the work changes, never the report
                    --jobs N evaluates mutants in N processes (default: available cores,
                    or $COAX_MUTATE_JOBS); the report is the same for every N
                    --shard I/N runs mutants I-1, I-1+N, ... and prints a record on stdout
                    --merge RECORD (repeated) combines all N records into the full report
       coax explain CODE | --all [--markdown]
       coax version
       coax source-digest ROOT          (the hash of ROOT/coax's compiler sources)
       coax status [--json]
